text:
anya: heads up — we have 3 deprecations landing next month (auth v1 removal, streaming-frame tweak, embed-dim bump). worried about meshing effects on clients that rely on multiple combos. propose a short 'grace window' where we accept old+new plus emit combined telemetry flag. thoughts?

matt: agree, clients will see combinatorial states. can we add a 'compat-mesh' header so proxies can opt-in to translation? e.g., `X-RW-Compat-Mesh: enable`

sanjay: +1. but careful: translations for streaming frames are lossy. prefer server-side fallback policy: prefer newest behavior but keep old code path for flagged tenants for 30 days.

anya: timeline: plan is staged waves: opt-in canary (1%), then 10%, then full. need a way to surface tenant opt-in easily in console and to billing/SLAs.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary rollout starts 2026-04-05 02:00 UTC. healthchecks auto-rollback on 5xx spike > 0.5%.

jen: what about SDKs? we should ship small client-side adapter that reads X-RW-Compat-Mesh and normalizes frames. less pressure on runtime.

kevin: SDKs are fine but not all customers update quickly. we need server-side telemetry to segment errors by client version + mesh-header + route.

anya: proposal: 1) add compat-mesh header; 2) runtime does translation for requests with header=true for 60 days; 3) emit telemetry: compat_mesh=on/off and migrated=true/false; 4) Console shows migration progress; 5) after 60d drop translation. any blockers?

matt: need a feature flag gate per-tenant. also quota and rate-limit counting must be invariant when translating to avoid billing surprises.

sanjay: also ensure KV cache keys are versioned — otherwise translations will corrupt cached prefixes. add model_version + compat_tag into cache key.

docs-bot: Docs action item: add "compat-mesh" header doc, examples for node/python, migration checklist.

anya: sample header snippet for reference:
```
X-RW-Compat-Mesh: true
X-RW-Compat-Mesh-Mode: permissive  # permissive | strict
```

matt: for permissive mode runtime accepts old frames and rewrites to new. strict rejects old frames with 422 and returns migration hints.

jen: can we add a temporary 'mesh-debug' cookie that returns conversion logs in response body for canary tenants? useful for debugging.

kevin: telemetry event schema: compat.mesh.enabled (bool), compat.mesh.mode (string), compat.translated (bool), compat.client_version (string). ping me and I'll add to bigquery.

anya: ok. next steps: write RFC follow-up with these decisions, infra to add tenant flag + rollback hook, SDKs to release adapter, docs to publish. I'll schedule RFC PR for Monday. thanks :raised_hands:

infra-bot: canary rollout acknowledged. monitoring dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/compat-mesh/5070001234
